description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

You have been touched by the element of fire and learned to control it with your mind. Sparks of flame flicker in the air around you in an alarming way. You can, with a successful Average (+20) Willpower Test, increase the heat in the air within Willpower yards to instantly make it catch fire. You can light torches and camp fires this way, or if a target is wearing flammable clothes or fur you can set them @Condition[Ablaze]. A fumbled roll will result in a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}. With a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test you can conjure a blast of fire with an area of effect equal to your Willpower Bonus yards. The damage is determined by your Willpower Bonus +SL. The targets' Toughness and Armour protect as per usual. Anyone within the range must pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 @Condition[Ablaze] Condition. A fumbled roll will result in a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}.
